declarations.docstring: The representation indexed by the pointwise successor is isomorphic to the tensor product of the original representation with an auxiliary finite-dimensional representation.
The successor-indexed representation is isomorphic to the tensor product of the original representation and an auxiliary representation.
An auxiliary finite-dimensional representation of the general linear group.
An auxiliary representation on a subtype defined by membership in an indexed collection.
Incrementing every index multiplies the auxiliary polynomial by the product of the polynomial variables.
The auxiliary invariant of the subtype representation with shifted parameter agrees with that of the corresponding finite-dimensional representation.
The additive commutative group structure on the auxiliary membership subtype.
The finite-dimensional representation for the incremented index is isomorphic to the auxiliary subtype representation.
The tensor product of an indexed representation with an auxiliary representation is isomorphic to the auxiliary subtype representation.
The right tensor unitor intertwines the indicated auxiliary subtype action with the tensor-product action.
The representation of the general linear group on the specified exterior-power subtype.
The exterior-power representation acts by scalar multiplication by the determinant.
A second auxiliary finite-dimensional representation of the general linear group.
An isomorphism between the two auxiliary finite-dimensional representations.
A linear equivalence from the specified exterior-power subtype to the base field.
The exterior-power linear equivalence evaluates through the alternating map associated with the standard basis determinant.
The exterior-power linear equivalence intertwines the exterior-power action with multiplication by the determinant.
